IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Kline, Franklin, Mulliken, Keiser, Rockefeller and Shin

Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting prosecution of persons reporting drug overdoses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting drug overdoses; and adding a newsection to chapter 69.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person shall not be charged, subject to civil forfeiture, orotherwise prosecuted for a violation of this chapter if: (1) The person was a witness to a drug overdose; (2) The overdose resulted in an imminent threat to the health orlife of the overdose victim; (3) The person reported the drug overdose to law enforcement orsummoned medical assistance at the time it was witnessed; and (4) All evidence of the specific violation was gained as a resultof the person's report.
